studies.title: Chip transaction authentication
studies.action: Approve a synthetic card packet, alter its amount, replay it, and compare a different checkout challenge.
studies.outcome: Observe issuer decisions for matching, modified, repeated, and wrong-checkout packets.
studies.limits: HMAC-SHA-256 over invented fields; not an EMV application cryptogram, test vector, chip command, issuer policy, or offline-authentication implementation.

studies.title: The curator’s message
studies.action: Compare independently received revocations, copied keys, metadata and declared attacker capabilities across existing labs.
studies.outcome: Record evidence and remaining assumptions for a fictional archive’s incident response.
studies.execution: guided case with a declared capability model
studies.limits: No message transport, endpoint exploit, new cryptographic implementation, security score or proof of safety.
